auth.note: Sign in to Instagram in a browser on this computer, then paste the sessionid cookie from its storage: the value alone, or the whole cookie header so csrftoken comes with it. A cookies.txt export on this computer can be named in the plugin's settings instead. Neither leaves this computer.

settings.label: Instagram session id
settings.description: The sessionid cookie of a browser signed in on this computer, or its whole cookie header when csrftoken comes with it. It stays here and is never sent to your account.

settings.label: Cookie file
settings.description: A cookies.txt export from a browser on this computer. Used when no sessionid is pasted above, so a long value is never cut short.

settings.label: How many comments
settings.description: Read newest first. A larger number costs another request for every fifty comments.

settings.label: Start with the caption
settings.description: Put the post's own caption above the comments.

settings.label: Read the replies under a comment
settings.description: A popular post costs one request per comment for this, so the thread is stopped after twenty-five.

settings.label: Keep the comment thread on this computer
settings.description: A kept thread is shown again instead of asking Instagram. It stays out of the database, so the archive cannot search it. A transcript is stored on the entry instead.

settings.label: How many days a kept thread lasts
settings.description: 0 keeps it until the plugin's own data is removed.

settings.label: Whisper model file
settings.description: A GGML model outside the plugin's models folder. Left empty, the first model in that folder is used.

settings.label: Spoken language
settings.description: Two letters, such as en or de. auto lets whisper listen and decide.
